title: HR Administrator
description:
We are looking for an HR & Office Administrative Assistant to join our clients growingteam. In your role as an HR & Office Administrative Assistant, you will report to the Global HR Manager. To support the office culture and logistics, you will be required to work from the office 3 days a week, with every Wednesday being an all company day, with the remaining two days worked remotely.

You will be responsible for managing end-to-end office operations and serving as a key operational hub for HR and employee experience.

Office Logistics & Facilities:
- Vendor Management: Acting as the primary point of contact for the landlord and
- external vendors, such as electricians and plumbers.
- Supply Management: Managing the ordering of office supplies and maintaining
- inventory.
- Health & Safety: Ensuring the office remains a safe environment and staying compliant
- with health and safety standards.
- Team Events: Coordinating team lunches and planning events for the Summer and
- Christmas parties, as well as smaller ad-hoc gatherings.
- General Admin: Providing general business administration support to ensure efficient
- operations.

HR & Employee Lifecycle
- HR Data & Systems Management: Maintain HR software by accurately inputting
- employee details and tracking annual leave, sickness, and attendance
- Recruitment Assistance: Providing assistance with recruitment and candidate sourcing,
- screening, and referencing.
- Onboarding & Offboarding: Assisting with the onboarding and offboarding of
- employees to ensure a seamless transition for all staff.
- Policy Guidance: Developing a strong knowledge and understanding of company
- policies to provide accurate advice and support to the team. Assist in drafting, updating,
- and implementing HR policies
- HR Research & Initiatives: Assisting with research on upcoming HR initiatives and
- providing administrative support for the People team.
- Travel & Scheduling: Managing team travel arrangements and booking meetings and
- candidate interviews.

Requirements
- Up to 2 years of experience in a similar administrative or HR role.
- Communication: Have excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with
- internal teams and external stakeholders.
- Soft Skills: Leverage emotional intelligence and active listening skills to work harmoniously and
- effectively with others.
- Organisation: Be diligent and attentive to detail with a strong ability to resolve issues in a timely and
- efficient manner.
- Tech Savvy: Be adept at working with Microsoft Office/G-Suite and comfortable working with
- different technologies.
- Attitude: Have a "can do" attitude to taking on new challenges

title: HR and People Coordinator
description:
Our client is a leading London based recycling and waste management organisation supporting construction, commercial, local authority and waste-sector clients with sustainable resource management.

They are seeking an experienced HR & People Coordinator to support the Head of HR & People with day-to-day HR administration and people-related activities across the business. The role will support the full employee lifecycle while contributing to HR projects, employee engagement and best practice.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage HR administration including contracts, offer letters, Right to Work checks, references, probation, changes to terms and leaver processes.
- Coordinate the HR induction programme and maintain accurate employee records and HR systems.
- Support absence management, return-to-work meetings, medical referrals and workplace adjustments.
- Assist with disciplinary, capability and grievance processes, including minute-taking.
- Support recruitment activities including advertising, candidate screening, interview coordination and candidate feedback.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date job descriptions and the job role library.
- Support employee engagement surveys and wider HR projects.
- Coordinate training and development administration, including apprenticeships, work experience and management training.
- Assist with the annual appraisal process.
- Maintain employee data and support HR reporting.
- Travel to other sites on an ad-hoc basis when required.

Requirements
- Previous experience in HR administration, ideally within a multi-site organisation.
- Good knowledge of HR processes and practices.
- Experience using HR systems and producing HR reports.
- CIPD Level 3 or equivalent preferred.
- Experience in the construction/waste management sector - desirable
- The successful candidate must be able to drive and travel to other depot locations as required
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Professional, empathetic and confidential approach.
- Ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Proactive and collaborative approach with the ability to work independently.

What We're Looking For
- A proactive and organised HR professional who can manage a varied workload.
- Someone who builds strong relationships and provides a professional and supportive service to employees and managers.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information.
- A flexible approach and willingness to support wider HR initiatives.

This role is ideal for an experienced HR Administrator or HR Coordinator looking to develop their career within a growing, multi-site organisation.
- Pay/Salary: 30 K - 35 K per annum
- Location: London

Cavendish Recruitment Professionals Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, sexual orientation, religion, or belief.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Your new role
Are you an organised and proactive HR Administrator looking for your next opportunity? Do you enjoy supporting people, coordinating recruitment activities and being involved in employee engagement initiatives? If so, we'd love to hear from you.
Our client is seeking an HR Administrator to join their established HR team on a 12 month maternity cover contract, with the potential for the role to become permanent for the right person. Based on a large and busy distribution site, this is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their HR career within a supportive and fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the recruitment process, including interview administration and coordination
- Assisting with candidate interviews and onboarding activities
- Providing general HR administration support
- Taking notes during investigations, disciplinary meetings and other HR related meetings
- Supporting employee engagement initiatives and projects
- Maintaining accurate employee records and HR documentation
- Assisting the HR team with day to day HR activities across the site

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous administration experience, within HR or recruitment
- Excellent organisational and communication skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office, including Outlook and Excel
- Ability to handle confidential information professionally
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
- Knowledge of employment law would be advantageous
- Experience within logistics or a fast-paced operational environment would be beneficial, but is not essential
- Positive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop

What you'll get in return
25 days annual leave
Pension Scheme
Healthcare and dental cover Employee benefits platform and discounts
Cycle to work scheme

Subsidised on-site canteen

title: HR Co-ordinator
company: Gordon Yates Recruitment Consultancy - Agency - Contract
description:
HR Coordinator
We are seeking an individual to start immediately on a Temp basis for 2-3 months; with a possible extension
34-36,000
Who you will be working for?
Our Client is a not for profit and well known innovative organisation in the centre of London
The role is 4 days in the office to start with - with Fridays from home-
What will you be doing?
We re looking for a highly organised and proactive HR Coordinator to join our People Team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone in their HR career who has generalist experience across the full employee lifecycle in a purpose-led organisation.
You ll play a key role in ensuring our People processes run smoothly and professionally, supporting recruitment, onboarding, employee relations administration, and day-to-day HR operations. As one of the first points of contact for People queries, you ll help deliver a responsive, high-quality service that supports both our colleagues and our organisational goals.
This role will report into the Head of People.
About You
- Supporting end-to-end recruitment activity, including advertising roles, coordinating shortlisting and interviews, and ensuring a positive candidate experience
- Managing onboarding processes, including pre-employment checks, contracts, and induction coordination in line with safer recruitment requirements
- Processing employee lifecycle changes such as new starters, leavers, and contract variations, ensuring accuracy across systems and records
- Acting as a first point of contact for HR queries via shared inboxes, responding promptly and escalating where appropriate
- Providing administrative support on low-level employee relations matters, including sickness absence and routine casework
- Supporting payroll processes by ensuring accurate and timely submission of employee data and changes
- Maintaining accurate HR records and supporting reporting and compliance requirements
- Assisting with wider People initiatives, policy updates, and projects as the team continues to evolve

About you
- Strong administrative and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail
- Confident managing multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
- A clear interest in developing a career in HR / People
- Strong communication skills and a professional, approachable manner
- Discreet and able to handle sensitive information with care
- Experience in a HR or administrative role is desirable

Essential
- 3+ year in a coordinator role
- CIPD Level 3 qualified or equivalent experience
- Knowledge of basic UK employment law

title: HR Officer
description:
HR Officer

We are looking for an organised and proactive HR Officer to join our friendly HR team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills who is passionate about delivering an efficient and professional HR service. The successful candidate will support all aspects of the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, safeguarding checks, payroll administration, employee records, absence management, and HR compliance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Support recruitment, onboarding and employee administration.
- Complete pre-employment checks, including references, DBS, qualifications and right to work.
- Maintain accurate employee records and the Single Central Register.
- Assist with payroll administration and HR reporting.
- Support absence management and probation processes.
- Provide advice and support on HR policies and procedures.
- Respond to HR queries and work closely with managers across the organisation.
- Help maintain confidential HR systems and ensure compliance with employment legislation.

About You:
- Previous HR or administration experience is desirable.
- Excellent organisational and communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage confidential information.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and HR systems.
- Able to work independently and as part of a team.

Safeguarding
We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful applicant will be required to undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including barred list checks, and all pre-employment safeguarding checks.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy early. Early applications are encouraged.
